item.title: The No. 1 Horror Movie of 2026 Is Officially Leaving Peacock
item.description: Not many directors can say their debut film was a blockbuster hit, let alone a cultural phenomenon. But newcomer Curry Barker, who wrote and directed Obsession , the No. 1 horror movie of 2026 , can say he's accomplished both. The film takes a look at the dangers of getting exactly what you wish for when Bear (Michael Johnston) makes a wish that his friend Nikki Freeman (Inde Navarrette) would love him more than anyone else in the world. Despite being made on only a $750,000 budget, the film dominated the box office when it hit theaters, earning $17.2 million in its first week and a staggering $23.9 million in its second week.

item.title: Dropout’s Vic Michaelis Wants to Toss Their Star Wars Character Out a Window
item.description: Dropout star Vic Michaelis used to fall asleep to Attack of the Clones . Not because they hated it, like so many Star Wars prequel detractors, but because it was their comfort watch. “I've seen the first 45 minutes of Episode II , I want to say, 300 times,” Michaelis told Polygon. “It's so comforting. The prequels hold a place in my heart where it is like nothing bad can happen when I'm watching them.”

item.title: Grand Theft Auto 6 Physical Copies Are Officially in the Wild
item.description: With preloads for Grand Theft Auto 6 just around the corner, Rockstar Games has sent the code-in-box editions to retailers, so stores can deliver them to customers on time. Shipments have started to arrive, giving us a first look at the physical edition of Grand Theft Auto 6 .

item.title: Wardogs Season 3 Will Add A Mode That Limits What Weapons Players Can Use
item.description: Bulkhead and Team17 shared the first details on what players can expect from Wardogs Season 3 in a new video. One of the most notable additions is Limited Mode, a new way to play Wardogs that restricts what weapons and other upgrades players have access to.

item.title: Path of Exile 2 Sets The Stage For Massive Update Alongside December Launch
item.description: At ExileCon 2026, Grinding Gear Games gave us a deep dive into everything we can expect to be added to Path of Exile 2 by the time its 1.0 launch happens next month. That includes a new stealth-driven class, two more narrative acts for its campaign, and a new league called Conquerors of Wraeclast .

item.title: GI Joe and Paranormal Activity Get New Official Release Dates from Paramount
item.description: Paramount Pictures has announced that Danny McBride's G.I. Joe reboot is expected to premiere in movie theaters in late 2028. Unfortunately, not all news is good; Paramount has also pushed back the next installment in the Paranormal Activity horror series by six months.

item.title: One Of Hollywood's Biggest Stars Just Auditioned For James Bond
item.description: As auditions for the next James Bond continue, new names are emerging and revealing which actors are up for the role. The latest on this from The Hollywood Reporter was particularly surprising, as it revealed some A-list Hollywood talent screen-tested for 007.
